# Dexent Logistics — Truck Dispatch Service

> Dexent Logistics is a truck dispatch service for owner-operators and small fleets in the United States. We dispatch Power Only, Dry Van, Reefer, and Flatbed freight nationwide, competing on carriers' net-per-mile rather than the lowest fee. Based in Washington, DC; dispatching nationwide.

## Pricing (authoritative)

- New MC authorities (0–3 months): $100/month + 8% per load, then just 8% after 3 months (the monthly fee drops off).
- Established carriers: 8% per load for 1–5 trucks, 7% for 6–10 trucks, 6% for 10+ trucks.
- No contracts, no setup fees, no hidden costs.

## Services

- [Truck Dispatch Services](https://dexentlogistics.com/dispatch): Overview of all equipment types.
- [Power Only Dispatch](https://dexentlogistics.com/dispatch/power-only): Tractor-only carriers, drop-and-hook and pre-loaded trailers.
- [Dry Van Dispatch](https://dexentlogistics.com/dispatch/dry-van): General palletized and consumer freight.
- [Reefer Dispatch](https://dexentlogistics.com/dispatch/reefer): Temperature-controlled produce, frozen, dairy, and protein freight.
- [Flatbed Dispatch](https://dexentlogistics.com/dispatch/flatbed): Steel, lumber, machinery, and construction freight.

- [Pricing](https://dexentlogistics.com/pricing): Full transparent pricing and what the fee includes.

- [Roll With Dexent](https://dexentlogistics.com/roll-with-dexent): Sticker referral program — a free week of dispatch every 2 months.

## Resources

- [Resources & Guides](https://dexentlogistics.com/resources): Guides for owner-operators and new authorities.
- [Free Tools](https://dexentlogistics.com/tools): Cost-per-mile and other calculators.

## Differentiators

- Competes on net-per-mile (what the carrier keeps after the fee), not the lowest percentage.
- Works with brand-new MC authorities that many dispatchers decline.
- Transparent, consistent pricing stated the same everywhere.
- No contracts.
